agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: We spent eight on the field yesterday. Water is the constraint that ends farms, and a cistern that only goes down is how that story starts.
today.expect: Cistern refilled enough that another clear day is not a gamble.

yesterday.why: The row is in the ground now. Clear sky will pull moisture under twenty if we wait, and a farm that cannot water what it planted is the one that ends.
yesterday.expect: East field wet enough that the sprout holds through another clear day.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: The ditch is cut. Heat does not wait, and watering through a new cut is the first proof it holds.
today.expect: The growing row gets a ditch-boosted soak so moisture stays well above twenty.

yesterday.why: Ditches compound and heat does not wait. A cut today means every watering after this holds longer.
yesterday.expect: An irrigation ditch so the field stops bleeding moisture on clear days.
yesterday.result: Irrigation ditch cut. Moisture will hold longer.
